title: Drupal Warns of New Highly Critical Site Takeover Vulnerability Under Active Exploitation
summary: Drupal has warned of a new "highly critical" security flaw impacting Drupal core that it said has been exploited in the wild.

title: Hackers Exploit 10 Vulnerabilities Across Mitel, Juniper, Vates, and Danfoss Products
summary: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Wednesday added 10 security flaws to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, including five vulnerabilities impacting Mitel MiCollab that were disclosed last week.

title: 1Password Hacked, Customer Data and Source Code Stolen in GitHub Account Breach
